---
name: Calculation or Data Error
about: Report incorrect calculations or missing canonical, profile, species, move, item, or trainer data.
title: ""
labels: bug
assignees: ""
---

# KM Companion version

Use the version shown in **Settings**, or give the commit when testing source.

# Profile, generation, and battle format

Name the selected ROM hack profile, base generation, Singles or Doubles format, and any active field rules.

# Attacker

List the species or form, level, ability, item, nature, stats, boosts, status, and other values that affect the result.

# Defender

List the species or form, level, ability, item, nature, stats, boosts, status, and other values that affect the result.

# Move and result

Name the move and give the result KM Companion displayed. Remove private nicknames from exported sets.

# Expected result and source

Explain the expected behavior and link a public authoritative source or a reproducible comparison when available. Clearly distinguish canonical game behavior from ROM hack changes.

# Imported data context

If the report involves a save, trainer pack, or profile adapter, give its public name, version, authors, and source. Do not upload the private source file.

# Screenshots

Add cropped screenshots only when they clarify the inputs or result. Redact local paths, account names, notifications, save details, and unrelated applications.

# File safety

Do not attach ROMs, game dumps, console keys, executable game files, copyrighted assets, private saves, credentials, signing material, personal data, complete generated mods, or private trainer research.
